title: Met someone last night
content: This is gonna be a long shot, but in my mall world I was at one of my “homes” and some workers had to come and fix something at the house. They were working in the living room and outside and I had come into the living room to shut the front door because it was wide open. I made eye contact with one of the workers and he smiled at me. I smiled back and turned away quickly and went to my room. He was taller than me, had dark hair, almost like the old Bieber hair but straight, had a mustache and it was more sparse, same with his beard. He was pretty skinny, maybe a tiny bit of weight and was somewhat rough looking but clean… are you real???
